# SD13-E2-R3 deterministic Half-Orc Barbarian level 1 interaction pressure fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Half-Orc Barbarian level 1 chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
#
# This fixture exists to prove the generalized race + class interaction-pressure model
# on a non-Human and non-Fighter combination. The deterministic pilot grounds no
# Half-Orc racial traits (ability-bonus selection, ferocity, darkvision, intimidation,
# or any other racial trait) and no Barbarian level-1 class chassis. It only needs the
# minimum race + class identity + ability scores to exercise the bounded interaction
# posture seam.
#
# No Human-specific race choices (`choice:human_ability_bonus`, `choice:human_bonus_feat`)
# are present because the chosen race is not Human. No `choice:fighter_bonus_feat`,
# `choice:fighter_bonus_feat_2`, or `choice:level_1_character_feat` selections are
# present because the chosen class is not Fighter. The deterministic pilot's
# claim-blocking posture for this input remains `class_chassis.unsupported` (Barbarian
# is not in the bounded fighter-shaped chassis seam) and `race.semantics.unverified`
# (Half-Orc race semantics are unverified). The generalized interaction-pressure model
# runs alongside these and declares the bounded posture record and posture diagnostic
# without asserting any computed mechanical value.
case_id=pf1-crb-half-orc-barbarian-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:half-orc
class_level=class:barbarian:1
ability=strength:16
